definitions.explanation: Done or handled as a separate matter, not included in the main item or arrangement. Frequently used in business and commercial contexts to indicate that something requires separate handling or payment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{送料|そうりょう}→送料：06128_souryou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{別途|べっと}⟦かかります→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
⟦{詳細|しょうさい}→詳細：02523_shousai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{別途|べっと}ご⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦いたします→いたす：01314_itasu⟧。
examples.english: We will contact you separately with the details.

examples.japanese: ⟦{宿泊費|しゅくはくひ}→宿泊費：25963_shukuhakuhi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ほか⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、{食事代|しょくじだい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{別途|べっと}⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なります→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: In addition to the accommodation fee, meal charges are required separately.

notes:
{別途|べっと} indicates that something is handled, charged, or communicated separately from the main matter. It is a formal word used overwhelmingly in business and commercial contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {別途|べっと}⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧: separate charge
- {別途|べっと}⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧: additional cost
- {別途|べっと}ご⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧: separate notification
- {別途|べっと}⟦{購入|こうにゅう}→購入：03057_kounyuu⟧: purchased separately
- {別途|べっと}⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧: separate procedure

USAGE:
Very common in price lists, contracts, invoices, and official communications. Often seen in the pattern {別途|べっと}〜⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧ (a separate ... is charged) or {別途|べっと}〜⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧ (separately ... is needed).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: separately (casual, everyday)
- ⟦{別個|べっこ}→別個：18408_bekko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: individually, separately (formal)
